_meanings:
A name given to certain sacred writings
 in verse (often in the form of a dialogue) which are devoted to the exposition
 of particular religious and theosophical doctrines; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} {#SivagItA#},
 {#rAmagItA, BagavadgItA#}. But the name appears to be especially confined
 to the last, the Bhagavadgītā; {#gItAsugItA kartavyA kimanyEH SAstravistarEH .#}
 {#yA svayaM padmanABasya muKapadmAdviniHsftA ..#} quoted by Śrīdharasvāmin.
